Everything works. Let me give a summary.

## Summary

Built a self-contained C++20 MARC 21 bibliographic tool in `output/`. Architecture:

- **`extract_rules.py`** — Parses the LOC bibliographic HTML corpus once at development time, extracting per-tag indicator/subfield/repeatability rules into `marc_rules_data.cpp`. Field 880 is marked permissive (defers to associated field).
- **`marc_rules_data.cpp`** — Generated table embedding 236 field rules (`bd001`-`bd887`).
- **`encoding.{h,cpp}`** — UTF-8 validator (rejects overlongs, surrogates, codepoints > U+10FFFF), and base64 encode/decode.
- **`json.{h,cpp}`** — Standalone JSON parser/serializer (no third-party deps).
- **`marc_record.{h,cpp}`** — Canonical types (`Record`, `ControlField`, `DataField`, `Subfield`), JSON conversion, and leader template normalization (positions 00-04 / 12-16 → `0`).
- **`marc_iso2709.cpp`** — ISO 2709 parser (validates leader fixed positions, directory layout, field terminator, subfield delimiter, UTF-8 of payload bytes) and renderer (computes record length and base address into the leader on output).
- **`marc_marcxml.cpp`** — Standalone XML parser handling namespaces (default and prefixed), entities (named + numeric), CDATA, and comments. Validates slim namespace, root element (`<record>` or `<collection>` with one `<record>`), child ordering (controlfield before datafield), tag/indicator/subfield attributes.
- **`marc_validate.cpp`** — Cross-checks every parsed record against the rules table for tag format, indicator allowed-set, subfield allowed-set, and repeatability at both field and subfield level.
- **`main.cpp`** — Dispatches `inspect` / `inspect_marcxml` / `render_iso2709` / `render_marcxml`. Uses `invalid_record` for inspect-time MARC violations and `invalid_request` for everything else (bad JSON, bad action, bad render input). Exit codes 0/1/2 as specified.
- **`CMakeLists.txt`** — Builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. Standard library only.
